title: Netcast
tagline: Netcast enables privacy preserving web3 social content distribution through zero knowledge machine learning enabling every content to be attested from it was original produced.
description:
Netcast enables privacy preserving web3 social content distribution through zero knowledge machine learning enabling every content to be attested from it was original produced. This prevents deep fakes in the error of AI by enabling video and audio recordings to be attested through the microphone and camera. 

Content producers can attach/sign content with zk proofs to distinguish them from any other AI generated content online with a verified sticker similar to a verified account
how_its_made:
The project leverages full stack agile development approach with frontend in Reactjs, NextJS, Backend in Postgress.

The blockchain stack includes solidity smart contracts, ipfs, foundry and fvm. We also used filecoin storage and zkSnarks for privacy preserving dat storage and attesting of content
